meta.description: Test matrix for my_deeplink_sdk example app — edit URLs and short codes to match your backend.
meta.ios_note: Custom scheme mydeeplinksdk is registered in Info.plist. Universal Links for https require Associated Domains + AASA on the host.
meta.routing_note: Keys live in the API link payload field `data` (SDK: customData). The URL/short_code only picks which link to load — use two dashboard links with different `data` (e.g. {"Vande":"Matram"} vs {"Bharat":"Mahan"}) for two screens. If one link returns both keys, the example opens Vande first, then you can extend the mapper.

test_urls.title: HTTPS — short code in path (dashboard link)
test_urls.notes: Opens in browser if App Link is not verified. Use adb to force-open the app, or custom-scheme tests first.

test_urls.title: Custom scheme — short_code query
test_urls.notes: Most reliable for emulator/device without assetlinks.

test_urls.title: Custom scheme — demo host + query
test_urls.notes: Same as above; host is ignored by the SDK (query carries the code).

adb.android_https: adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "https://backend-dynamiclink.tecocraft.us/GGkuXr" com.tecocraft.sdk.my_deeplink_sdk_example
adb.android_custom_query: adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "mydeeplinksdk://open?short_code=GGkuXr" com.tecocraft.sdk.my_deeplink_sdk_example
